# Adjudication Task — Chapter 290

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃290화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|스킬창
  6|
  7|
  8|
  9|[비급 제작]
 10|
 11|등급 : 無
 12|
 13|제한 : 대성을 이룬 무공
 14|
 15|설명 : 시전자가 대성을 이룬 무공에 한하여 비급을 제작할 수 있다. 무공에 대한 이해도가 깊다면 더 좋은 결과가 나올지도?
 16|
 17|특이사항 : 비급을 제작하기 위한 재료가 필요함.
 18|
 19|
 20|
 21|
 22|
 23|스킬 정보창을 보며 생각했다.
 24|
 25|가만있자, 이걸 언제 받았더라?
 26|
 27|‘진가보법을 대성했을 때였나? 아니면 진가창법?’
 28|
 29|일 년도 넘은지라 기억이 가물가물하다.
 30|
 31|어쩌다 보니 스킬을 받긴 했는데, 막상 쓸 곳이 없어서 단 한 번도 사용해 본 적이 없었기 때문이다.
 32|
 33|‘아니지, 정확히 말하면 쓸 곳이 없었던 게 아니라 쓸 생각이 없었던 거지.’
 34|
 35|현대에 돌아와 평화 길드원들을 마주할 때마다 간혹 그런 충동이 들기는 했었다. 그러나 매번 내리는 최종 결론은 ‘아니다’ 였다.
 36|
 37|‘무공을 유출시켰다가 무슨 곤욕을 치르려고.’
 38|
 39|누구는 청동기로 싸우는데, 어떤 놈이 강철 검을 들고 와 닥치는 대로 썰어 버린다고 생각해 봐라.
 40|
 41|누구나 그를 부러워할 것이고 강철 검을 차지하기 위해 개떼처럼 모여들 것이다.
 42|
 43|평화 길드원들을 못 믿는 건 아니지만, 적어도 그 당시에는 옳은 판단이었다고 생각한다.
 44|
 45|‘하지만 이제는 망설일 이유가 없지.’
 46|
 47|이정룡과 그 휘하에 있는 박지훈, 석고준과 직접 손을 섞으며 깨달았다. 현대에도 내가 알지 못하는 비밀이 있다는 것을.
 48|
 49|놈들의 움직임과 마나의 운용은 분명 무림인에 가까운 그것이었다. 적이 강철 검으로 무장했다면 우리도 비슷한 장비를 갖춰야 한다.
 50|
 51|“후우…….”
 52|
 53|크게 숨을 들이마시자 구린내가 콧속으로 빨려 들어온다.
 54|
 55|지금 내가 쪼그려 앉아 있는 곳은 화장실 칸막이다.
 56|
 57|환경은 최악이지만 사람 눈에 띄지 않고 무공 비급을 제작하기에는 적격이었다.
 58|
 59|‘그럼 어디 한번 시작해 볼까.’
 60|
 61|병원 내부 편의점에서 사 온 A4 용지와 펜을 촤르륵 펼쳤다.
 62|
 63|그리고 마음속으로 중얼거렸다.
 64|
 65|‘비급 제작 스킬 발동.’
 66|
 67|띠링.
 68|
 69|
 70|
 71|- 모든 재료가 완비되었습니다.
 72|
 73|- [비급 제작] 스킬이 활성화됩니다. 대성(大成)을 이룬 무공을 비급으로 제작할 수 있습니다.
 74|
 75|- 현재 제작 가능한 목록 : 진가심법, 진가보법, 진가창법.
 76|
 77|- 원하는 무공을 선택하십시오.
 78|
 79|
 80|
 81|현재 내가 익힌 열화문의 무공 중 대성을 이룬 것은 존재하지 않는다.
 82|
 83|반면 태원 진가의 가전 무공은 안정적이고, 무공이 가진 위력도 적당하다.
 84|
 85|나는 그중에서도 가장 근간이 되는 한 가지를 골랐다.
 86|
 87|‘진가심법 선택.’
 88|
 89|띠링.
 90|
 91|
 92|
 93|[진가심법]을 비급으로 제작하시겠습니까?
 94|
 95|Y / N
 96|
 97|
 98|
 99|‘예스.’
100|
101|삐빅! 삐빅!
102|
103|
104|
105|- 지능이 부족합니다! 능지가 부족합니다!
106|
107|- 가르치는 것은 익히는 것보다 몇 배는 어려운 법!
108|
109|- [절정] 등급의 무공을 비급으로 제작하기 위해서는 최소 100의 지력이 필요합니다!
110|
111|
112|
113|“……아, 개새끼들. 진짜.”
114|
115|나는 피눈물을 흘리며 상태창을 열었다.
116|
117|피 같은 포인트를 지력에 투자하자, 펜을 쥔 손이 저절로 A4 용지 위를 전광석화처럼 누볐다.
118|
119|촤촤촤촤촥!
120|
121|“헉!”
122|
123|두 번 놀랐다.
124|
125|그 엄청난 속도에 한 번, 그리고 쓰이는 모든 언어가 중국어라는 것에 두 번.
126|
127|“…….”
128|
129|씨벌, 못 해 먹겠네.
130|
131|나는 언어 설정을 찾아 헤매기 시작했다.
132|
133|
134|
135|* * *
136|
137|
138|
139|드르륵.
140|
141|평화 길드원들이 있는 병실로 들어섰다. 옹기종기 모여서 이야기를 나누고 있던 사람들이 나를 향해 고개를 돌린다.
142|
143|“어디 갔다 오길래 이렇게 늦…… 혹시 화장실 다녀왔어?”
144|
145|코를 움켜쥔 송송이의 말에 나는 음울하게 대답했다.
146|
147|“어떻게 알았냐.”
148|
149|“똥 냄새가 진동하길래.”
150|
151|“심해?”
152|
153|“응. 사람이 아니라 거대한 똥이 걸어오는 줄 알았어.”
154|
155|“덕담 고맙다. 기운이 나네.”
156|
157|냄새나는 화장실 칸막이에서 한 시간을 넘게 있다 보니 코가 마비됐다.
158|
159|나는 기운이 쪽 빠진 목소리로 대답하며 스테이플러로 찍은 A4 용지 묶음을 건넸다.
160|
161|“여기.”
162|
163|“이게 뭔데?”
164|
165|“널 위한 러브레터. 설사하면서 썼다.”
166|
167|“우웩, 우웨에엑!”
168|
169|“리액션 풍부한 것 보소.”
170|
171|“우웨에에엑!”
172|
173|“…….”
174|
175|리액션이 아니라 리얼이었네.
176|
177|이미 볼 장 다 봤다고 생각했지만, 마음 한구석이 아려 오는 건 어쩔 수 없다.
178|
179|“사랑했다…….”
180|
181|“우웨에에에엑!”
182|
183|“송송이 헌터님. 괜찮으십니까?”
184|
185|거세지는 헛구역질에 가장 가까이에 있던 김 집사가 나는 듯이 달려와 등을 두드려 주었다.
186|
187|그사이 송송이가 태극기처럼 휘두르던 A4 용지는 한 사람의 손에 넘어갔다.
188|
189|첫 면에 적힌 글자를 읽은 최 팀장이 나를 보며 피식 웃는다.
190|
191|“진가심법? 러브레터치고는 제목이 특이한데요.”
192|
193|“안에 적힌 내용은 더 특이할 겁니다.”
194|
195|“……네?”
196|
197|“계속 읽어 보세요.”
198|
199|최 팀장은 눈치가 빨랐다. 그는 즉시 자세를 바로 하고 신중한 얼굴로 페이지를 넘겼다.
200|
201|직접 썼다고는 믿기지 않을 만큼 기계 같은 필체 위를 한 쌍의 눈동자가 바쁘게 굴러다녔다.
202|
203|팔락. 팔락. 팔락…….
204|
205|속도는 점점 더 빨라졌고 최 팀장의 입술 사이로 더운 숨이 뿜어져 나왔다.
206|
207|순식간에 10여 페이지를 독파한 그가 고개를 번쩍 쳐들었다. 나를 보는 눈동자는 쟁반처럼 부풀어 있었다.
208|
209|“이건……!”
210|
211|그 반응에 나도 적잖이 놀랐다.
212|
213|‘이게 뭔지 알고 있다고?’
214|
215|말이 무공 비급이지, 막상 제작하고 보니 진가심법의 비급은 모르는 사람이 보면 한의학 서적으로 착각할 정도였다.
216|
217|인체에 존재하는 수많은 혈도의 위치와 그 기능, 공력을 운용하는 경로까지 표시되어 있으니까.
218|
219|송송이였다면 몇 장 보고 덮었을 테지만, 최 팀장의 반응은 생각했던 것 이상이었다.
220|
221|“뭔지 알아보겠습니까?”
222|
223|“예. 물론입니다.”
224|
225|이어 그의 입술 사이로 생전 처음 들어보는 명칭이 흘러나왔다.
226|
227|“이건…… 마나 연공법입니다.”
228|
229|“마나, 뭐요?”
230|
231|“마나 연공법 말입니다!”
232|
233|마나 연공법(Mana-練功法)?
234|
235|거, 누가 지었는지 이름 한 번 괴상하다.
236|
237|그때 최 팀장의 커진 목소리를 들은 김 집사가 후다닥 다가갔다.
238|
239|“지금 마나 연공법이라고 하셨습니까?”
240|
241|“네, 여기.”
242|
243|최 팀장으로부터 비급을 건네받은 김 집사가 황급히 페이지를 넘겼다.
244|
245|그리고 얼마 지나지 않아 비슷한 반응이 터져 나왔다.
246|
247|“헉.”
248|
249|“김 집사님이 보시기에 어떻습니까?”
250|
251|“확실합니다. 마나 연공법이 분명해요. 그런데 도대체 이걸 어디서?”
252|
253|화장실에서 가져왔는데요.
254|
255|최 팀장이 손가락을 들어 나를 가리켰다.
256|
257|“진태경 씨가…….”
258|
259|“진태경 헌터님이요?”
260|
261|휙! 우두둑!
262|
263|최 팀장의 말이 끝나기도 전에 김 집사의 고개가 맹렬한 소리와 함께 내 쪽을 향해 꺾였다.
264|
265|“진태경 헌터님께서 어떻게 마나 연공법을 갖고 계신 겁니까?”
266|
267|나는 침착하게 대답했다.
268|
269|“일단 저는 마나 연공법이 뭔지 모르고요. 당연히 저게 마나 연공법이라는 것 역시 금시초문입니다. 그나저나 목은 괜찮으세요? 방금 뼈 부러지는 소리가 들린 것 같은데…….”
270|
271|“지금 그게 대수입니까? 이깟 목, 부러져도 됩니다.”
272|
273|“……엄청 대수인 것 같은데.”
274|
275|되긴 뭐가 돼. 이 할아버지, 어째 날이 갈수록 터프해지시는 것 같다.
276|
277|물론 그만큼 이 문제가 중요하다는 뜻이겠지만.
278|
279|‘그나저나 마나 연공법이라. 이정룡이 그걸 익힌 거구나.’
280|
281|일종의 합성어라 처음에는 괴상하게 들렸는데, 몇 번 중얼거려보니 혀에 착 감긴다.
282|
283|단어에 담긴 뜻으로 헌터들이 쓰는 내공심법이라는 걸 유추하기는 그리 어렵지 않았다.
284|
285|그리고 이정룡과 그 수하들이 익힌 것이 바로 이 마나 연공법이라는 것도.
286|
287|“제 질문에 대한 답을 부탁드려도 되겠습니까?”
288|
289|“태경 씨, 이건 매우 중요한 문제입니다.”
290|
291|김 집사와 최 팀장의 눈빛은 그 어느 때보다 진지하고 심각했다.
292|
293|나는 짐짓 당황한 것처럼 눈을 굴리다가, 미리 준비해 온 대답을 던졌다.
294|
295|“글쎄요. 어릴 적에 아버지께서 알려 주신 거라…….”
296|
297|“외람되지만 혹시 돌아가신 선친(先親)을 말씀하시는 겁니까?”
298|
299|“네.”
300|
301|최 팀장이 미간을 좁혔다.
302|
303|“선친께서는 일반인이셨던 것으로 압니다만.”
304|
305|“맞아요.”
306|
307|“그런데 어떻게 마나 연공법을……?”
308|
309|“아마 아버지도 모르셨을 겁니다. 저한테 알려 주시면서 집안 대대로 내려오는 건강요법이라고만 말씀해 주셨거든요.”
310|
311|“네? 건강요법이요?”
312|
313|“집안 대대로 내려오는 마나 연공법이라니.”
314|
315|믿을 수 없다는 표정을 짓는 두 사람을 향해 표지 겉면을 가리켰다.
316|
317|오피스 문서의 폰트처럼 정갈한 글씨체로 적힌 네 글자.
318|
319|
320|
321|[진가심법]
322|
323|
324|
325|이름부터 딱 좋다.
326|
327|산서성에 태원진가가 있다면 경기도에는 고양진가가 있다, 이 말이야.
328|
329|집안에 대대로 내려온 가보(家寶)라고 하면 저쪽에서도 딱히 할 말이 없을 거다.
330|
331|내 예상대로 순간 말문이 막힌 두 사람을 보며 말을 이었다.
332|
333|“일종의 호흡법인데, 익히면 건강해진다고 어렸을 때부터 가르쳐 주셨어요. 구결(口訣)이라는 것도 달달 외우게 시키셨고.”
334|
335|“마나 연공법과 비슷하긴 한데…….”
336|
337|“원본, 원본을 볼 수 있겠습니까?”
338|
339|“아버지께서 돌아가신 후에 워낙 경황이 없어서…… 이사하고 나서 찾아봤는데 없어졌더라고요.”
340|
341|“아…….”
342|
343|“저런.”
344|
345|“안타까운 일이죠. 제가 토씨 한 글자 안 빼놓고 외워 놓아서 그나마 다행이지만.”
346|
347|사라진 물건이 있다는 말은 사실이다. 단지 그 와중에 있지도 않은 진가심법의 비급을 끼워 넣었을 뿐.
348|
349|완벽한 증거 인멸. 원본마저 없어졌다는 말에 두 사람이 어깨가 축 늘어지는 것이 보였다.
350|
351|‘이게 원본인 걸 알면 표정들 볼 만하겠는데.’
352|
353|사람들이 생각하는 무공 비급의 형태는 다 비슷비슷하다.
354|
355|반쯤 삭아 버린 죽간(竹竿). 쥐 오줌 냄새가 나는 고서(古書).
356|
357|족구 하라고 해라. 난 그딴 거 없다.
358|

“Keep reading.”

[P77]
Team Leader Choi was quick on the uptake. He immediately straightened and began turning the pages with a solemn expression.

[P78]
His eyes raced across handwriting so mechanical that it was hard to believe I had written it myself.

[P79]
Flip. Flip. Flip…

[P80]
His pace grew faster and faster, and hot breaths escaped between his lips.

[P81]
After tearing through ten-odd pages in an instant, he jerked his head up. His eyes had widened like saucers.

[P82]
“This is…!”

[P83]
Even I was taken aback by his reaction.

[P84]
*He knows what this is?*

[P85]
It might have been called a martial arts manual, but now that I had made it, anyone unfamiliar with the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique could easily have mistaken the manual for a traditional medicine text.

[P86]
It detailed the locations and functions of the countless acupoints in the human body, along with the pathways used to circulate internal energy.

[P87]
Song Song would have read a few pages and closed it, but Team Leader Choi’s reaction went far beyond anything I had expected.

[P88]
“Do you recognize it?”

[P89]
“Yes. Of course.”

[P90]
Then a term I had never heard before slipped from his lips.

[P91]
“This is a Mana Cultivation Method.”

[P92]
“A mana what?”

[P93]
“A Mana Cultivation Method!”

[P94]
*Mana Cultivation Method?*

[P95]
What a bizarre name. Whoever had coined it possessed a strange sense of style.

[P96]
Butler Kim hurried over when he heard Team Leader Choi raise his voice.

[P97]
“Did you just say Mana Cultivation Method?”

[P98]
“Yes. Here.”

[P99]
Butler Kim took the manual from Team Leader Choi and frantically flipped through the pages.

[P100]
Before long, he reacted much the same way.

[P101]
“Gasp.”

[P102]
“What do you think, Butler Kim?”

[P103]
“There’s no doubt about it. This is definitely a Mana Cultivation Method. But where on earth did this come from?”

[P104]
The bathroom.

[P105]
Team Leader Choi raised a finger and pointed at me.

[P106]
“Mr. Jin Taekyung…”

[P107]
“Hunter Jin Taekyung?”

[P108]
Whip! Crack!

[P109]
Before Team Leader Choi could finish, Butler Kim’s head snapped toward me with a series of violent cracks.

[P110]
“How does Hunter Jin Taekyung possess a Mana Cultivation Method?”

[P111]
I answered calmly.

[P112]
“For starters, I don’t know what a Mana Cultivation Method is. Naturally, this is also the first I’ve heard of that thing being one. By the way, is your neck all right? I could’ve sworn I just heard a bone break…”

[P113]
“Is that important right now? This little neck of mine can break for all I care.”

[P114]
“…It sounds pretty important to me.”

[P115]
What did he mean, it could break? This old man seemed to be getting tougher by the day.

[P116]
Of course, that only showed how important this was.

[P117]
*So Lee Jungryong learned a Mana Cultivation Method.*

[P118]
The compound term had sounded strange at first, but after repeating it a few times, it began to roll smoothly off my tongue.

[P119]
It wasn’t hard to infer from the name that it referred to an internal cultivation technique used by Hunters.

[P120]
And that Lee Jungryong and his subordinates had learned precisely such a technique.

[P121]
“Could you please answer my question?”

[P122]
“Taekyung, this is extremely important.”

[P123]
Butler Kim and Team Leader Choi looked more grave than ever.

[P124]
I glanced around as though flustered, then gave them the answer I had prepared in advance.

[P125]
“Well, my father taught it to me when I was young…”

[P126]
“Pardon me, but are you referring to your late father?”

[P127]
“Yes.”

[P128]
Team Leader Choi furrowed his brow.

[P129]
“I understand your late father was an ordinary man.”

[P130]
“That’s right.”

[P131]
“Then how did he know a Mana Cultivation Method…?”

[P132]
“He probably didn’t know either. When he taught it to me, he said it was just a health regimen passed down through our family.”

[P133]
“A health regimen?”

[P134]
“A Mana Cultivation Method passed down through the family…”

[P135]
As the two stared at me in disbelief, I pointed to the cover.

[P136]
Four neat characters were printed there in lettering as clean as an office document’s font.

[P137]
**Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique**

[P138]
Even the name was perfect.

[P139]
If Shanxi Province had the Jin Family of Taiyuan, then Gyeonggi Province had the Jin Family of Goyang. Simple as that.

[P140]
If I claimed it was a family heirloom passed down through the generations, they wouldn’t have much to argue with.

[P141]
As expected, they were both briefly rendered speechless. I continued.

[P142]
“It’s a kind of breathing method. My father started teaching it to me when I was young, saying that practicing it would make me healthier. He even made me memorize something called a formula word for word.”

[P143]
“It is similar to a Mana Cultivation Method, but…”

[P144]
“Could we see the original? The original manual?”

[P145]
“After my father passed away, everything was so chaotic… I looked for it after we moved, but it was gone.”

[P146]
“Ah…”

[P147]
“That’s unfortunate.”

[P148]
“It is. Fortunately, I memorized every last word.”

[P149]
It was true that something I owned had disappeared. I had merely slipped the nonexistent original manual for the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique into the story.

[P150]
Perfect destruction of evidence. When they heard that even the original was gone, both of their shoulders sagged.

[P151]
*I’d love to see their faces if they knew this was the original.*

[P152]
The martial arts manuals people imagined all looked more or less the same.

[P153]
Half-rotted bamboo slips. Ancient books reeking of rat piss.

[P154]
They could go play jokgu.[^2] I didn’t have any of that crap.

[P155]
I stood the crisp stack of A4 paper upright and slammed a stapler through it. Murim martial artists would have been appalled, but a twenty-first-century martial arts manual deserved to look the part.

[P156]
“Still, this is extraordinary. A cultivation technique… I never imagined such a thing truly existed.”

[P157]
“I’ve seen them mentioned a few times in novels and movies. I believe they called them martial arts.”

[P158]
“You are correct, Young Master. In a sense, a Mana Cultivation Method is also a form of martial arts. Look here. It says that qi is circulated and accumulated through energy circulation, does it not? This operates on the same principle as a Mana Cultivation Method…”

[P159]
*Yeah, because it is martial arts.*

[P160]
While I fought back the words itching to escape my mouth, Team Leader Choi asked me a question.

[P161]
“Then, Mr. Jin Taekyung, have you been practicing a Mana Cultivation Method—or rather, the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique—since childhood?”

[P162]
“Yes.”

[P163]
“I’m sorry to put it this way, but its effects seem somewhat less impressive than expected…”

[P164]
Translated directly, he was asking, *If you had this, why did you spend seven years as an F-rank Hunter?*

[P165]
A sharp question. Also one I had expected.

[P166]
I answered without batting an eye.

[P167]
“As you know, I was quite skilled for an F-rank Hunter. I even received a commendation for graduating at the top of my training center.”

[P168]
“Ah, yes. I heard about that. I also know you served as a deputy team leader in your former Guild.”

[P169]
Granted, it had been a tiny, weak Guild, but F-rank Hunters were treated like punching bags wherever they went—like dog shit on the street.

[P170]
Unless they were related to the Guild’s leadership, it was extremely rare for an F-rank Hunter to become a deputy team leader. That was why my appointment had remained a hot topic within the Guild for quite some time.

[P171]
“There was a lot of talk about it. Hunters with higher ranks and more experience than me complained about seniority and grumbled that they should have come first… In the end, I proved myself through sheer ability. And the reason I could do that was the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique.”

[P172]
“Hmm.”

[P173]
“Looking at it that way, it does seem to have had some effect.”

[P174]
I knew.

[P175]
This alone wouldn’t be enough to convince them that the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique explained my past.

[P176]
I smiled faintly and looked around. Song Song had finally stopped retching, and even Im Kkeokjeong was watching me with curiosity, waiting for what I would say next.

[P177]
[^1]: The Taegeukgi is South Korea’s national flag, commonly waved by hand at public events.
[^2]: *Jokgu* is Korean foot volleyball. Here, the phrase also works as a minced oath meaning “fuck off.”
```

# Mastering Adjudicator Brief

You are a **veto**, not a second novelist and not a gloss writer.

This call is isolated, non-interactive, and tool-free. The packet already contains the Korean source, both complete English versions, glossary matches, rules, and every numbered hunk. Do not call tools, search the repository, or read files. Do not announce a plan.

The first editor (SOL) has already rewritten the accepted English (BASELINE) for fluency. Default is `SOL`. Take `BASE` only when SOL is actually unfaithful. Write `REPAIR` only when **both** BASE and SOL are unfaithful.

## Default

Choose `SOL` unless a veto below fires.

Keep SOL when it is slangier, punchier, more spoken, or more idiomatic and the Korean sense holds (`기만질` → “con me”, `톡톡히` → “full Peak Master treatment”, `득실거리다` → “crawling with”, `인간 백정` → “butcher of men”, `한 몸` → “are one”, `시원하다` in a bath → “That’s the stuff”, `어렵게 찾아오고 쉽게 깨지는 법` → “hard-won and easily broken”). If SOL already naturalized Korean syntax (`이 혁무진` → “I, Hyuk Mujin”), keep SOL. Do not reproduce Korean word order.

**Literal closeness to Korean wording is not fidelity.** Preserve the source’s meaning and effect in natural English.

## Veto — choose `BASE`

Use `BASE` only for a real miss:

* wrong denotation, quantity, hedge, category, subject/object, or physical action
* a different English idiom than the Korean joke (`까발리다` ≠ “gives someone away”; `넉살` ≠ “banter”)

Do not veto SOL for being informal. Do not veto SOL to “clarify” slang. Do not veto SOL merely because BASELINE is already understandable.

## Critical binding translation rules

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

## Footnotes

Use `[^1]` Markdown footnotes when a brief, factual, spoiler-free explanation materially helps an English reader understand:

- a Korean institution, living arrangement, food, holiday, myth, historical reference, or local custom;
- a Korean word, phrase, idiom, wordplay, or culturally specific image that cannot be conveyed fully by the best natural English analogy;
- a deliberately literal rendering whose cultural or linguistic force would otherwise be lost.

For example, render `고시원` as “goshiwon” when the setting or connotations matter, with a concise footnote explaining that it is a very small, inexpensive room-for-rent housing arrangement. Define a term at its first meaningful occurrence and do not repeat the note unnecessarily. Footnotes must be rare, useful, and non-spoiling; do not footnote ordinary vocabulary, fully preserved jokes, or uncertainty. Record consequential uncertainty in `docs/STATE.md`.

## Spoilers and Scope

- Safe profiles contain only facts revealed through the latest completed chapter.

- Future knowledge may prevent contradiction but may not add early names, pronouns, certainty, motives, or foreshadowing.

If Shanxi Province had the Jin Family of Taiyuan, then Gyeonggi Province had the Jin Family of Goyang. Simple as that.

If I claimed it was a family heirloom passed down through the generations, they wouldn’t have much to argue with.

“It is similar to a Mana Cultivation Method, but…”

[P144]

[P145]
“After my father passed away, everything was so chaotic… I looked for it after we moved, but it was gone.”

[P146]
“Ah…”

[P147]
“That’s unfortunate.”

[P148]

It was true that something I owned had disappeared. I had merely slipped the nonexistent original manual for the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique into the story.

[P150]
Perfect destruction of evidence. When they heard that even the original was gone, both of their shoulders sagged.

[P151]
*I’d love to see their faces if they knew this was the original.*

[P152]
The martial arts manuals people imagined all looked more or less the same.

[P153]
Half-rotted bamboo slips. Ancient books reeking of rat piss.

[P154]
They could go play jokgu.[^2] I didn’t have any of that crap.

“Still, this is extraordinary. A cultivation technique… I never imagined such a thing truly existed.”

[P157]
“I’ve seen them mentioned a few times in novels and movies. I believe they called them martial arts.”

[P159]
*Yeah, because it is martial arts.*

[P161]

[P162]
“Yes.”

[P163]
“I’m sorry to put it this way, but its effects seem somewhat less impressive than expected…”

A sharp question. Also one I had expected.

[P168]
“Ah, yes. I heard about that. I also know you served as a deputy team leader in your former Guild.”

[P169]
Granted, it had been a tiny, weak Guild, but F-rank Hunters were treated like punching bags wherever they went—like dog shit on the street.

[P170]

[P171]
“There was a lot of talk about it. Hunters with higher ranks and more experience than me complained about seniority and grumbled that they should have come first… In the end, I proved myself through sheer ability. And the reason I could do that was the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique.”

[P172]
“Hmm.”

[P173]
“Looking at it that way, it does seem to have had some effect.”

[P174]
I knew.

[P175]
This alone wouldn’t be enough to convince them that the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique explained my past.

[P176]
I smiled faintly and looked around. Song Song had finally stopped retching, and even Im Kkeokjeong was watching me with curiosity, waiting for what I would say next.

# Adjudication Task — Chapter 290

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃290화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|스킬창
  6|
  7|
  8|
  9|[비급 제작]
 10|
 11|등급 : 無
 12|
 13|제한 : 대성을 이룬 무공
 14|
 15|설명 : 시전자가 대성을 이룬 무공에 한하여 비급을 제작할 수 있다. 무공에 대한 이해도가 깊다면 더 좋은 결과가 나올지도?
 16|
 17|특이사항 : 비급을 제작하기 위한 재료가 필요함.
 18|
 19|
 20|
 21|
 22|
 23|스킬 정보창을 보며 생각했다.
 24|
 25|가만있자, 이걸 언제 받았더라?
 26|
 27|‘진가보법을 대성했을 때였나? 아니면 진가창법?’
 28|
 29|일 년도 넘은지라 기억이 가물가물하다.
 30|
 31|어쩌다 보니 스킬을 받긴 했는데, 막상 쓸 곳이 없어서 단 한 번도 사용해 본 적이 없었기 때문이다.
 32|
 33|‘아니지, 정확히 말하면 쓸 곳이 없었던 게 아니라 쓸 생각이 없었던 거지.’
 34|
 35|현대에 돌아와 평화 길드원들을 마주할 때마다 간혹 그런 충동이 들기는 했었다. 그러나 매번 내리는 최종 결론은 ‘아니다’ 였다.
 36|
 37|‘무공을 유출시켰다가 무슨 곤욕을 치르려고.’
 38|
 39|누구는 청동기로 싸우는데, 어떤 놈이 강철 검을 들고 와 닥치는 대로 썰어 버린다고 생각해 봐라.
 40|
 41|누구나 그를 부러워할 것이고 강철 검을 차지하기 위해 개떼처럼 모여들 것이다.
 42|
 43|평화 길드원들을 못 믿는 건 아니지만, 적어도 그 당시에는 옳은 판단이었다고 생각한다.
 44|
 45|‘하지만 이제는 망설일 이유가 없지.’
 46|
 47|이정룡과 그 휘하에 있는 박지훈, 석고준과 직접 손을 섞으며 깨달았다. 현대에도 내가 알지 못하는 비밀이 있다는 것을.
 48|
 49|놈들의 움직임과 마나의 운용은 분명 무림인에 가까운 그것이었다. 적이 강철 검으로 무장했다면 우리도 비슷한 장비를 갖춰야 한다.
 50|
 51|“후우…….”
 52|
 53|크게 숨을 들이마시자 구린내가 콧속으로 빨려 들어온다.
 54|
 55|지금 내가 쪼그려 앉아 있는 곳은 화장실 칸막이다.
 56|
 57|환경은 최악이지만 사람 눈에 띄지 않고 무공 비급을 제작하기에는 적격이었다.
 58|
 59|‘그럼 어디 한번 시작해 볼까.’
 60|
 61|병원 내부 편의점에서 사 온 A4 용지와 펜을 촤르륵 펼쳤다.
 62|
 63|그리고 마음속으로 중얼거렸다.
 64|
 65|‘비급 제작 스킬 발동.’
 66|
 67|띠링.
 68|
 69|
 70|
 71|- 모든 재료가 완비되었습니다.
 72|
 73|- [비급 제작] 스킬이 활성화됩니다. 대성(大成)을 이룬 무공을 비급으로 제작할 수 있습니다.
 74|
 75|- 현재 제작 가능한 목록 : 진가심법, 진가보법, 진가창법.
 76|
 77|- 원하는 무공을 선택하십시오.
 78|
 79|
 80|
 81|현재 내가 익힌 열화문의 무공 중 대성을 이룬 것은 존재하지 않는다.
 82|
 83|반면 태원 진가의 가전 무공은 안정적이고, 무공이 가진 위력도 적당하다.
 84|
 85|나는 그중에서도 가장 근간이 되는 한 가지를 골랐다.
 86|
 87|‘진가심법 선택.’
 88|
 89|띠링.
 90|
 91|
 92|
 93|[진가심법]을 비급으로 제작하시겠습니까?
 94|
 95|Y / N
 96|
 97|
 98|
 99|‘예스.’
100|
101|삐빅! 삐빅!
102|
103|
104|
105|- 지능이 부족합니다! 능지가 부족합니다!
106|
107|- 가르치는 것은 익히는 것보다 몇 배는 어려운 법!
108|
109|- [절정] 등급의 무공을 비급으로 제작하기 위해서는 최소 100의 지력이 필요합니다!
110|
111|
112|
113|“……아, 개새끼들. 진짜.”
114|
115|나는 피눈물을 흘리며 상태창을 열었다.
116|
117|피 같은 포인트를 지력에 투자하자, 펜을 쥔 손이 저절로 A4 용지 위를 전광석화처럼 누볐다.
118|
119|촤촤촤촤촥!
120|
121|“헉!”
122|
123|두 번 놀랐다.
124|
125|그 엄청난 속도에 한 번, 그리고 쓰이는 모든 언어가 중국어라는 것에 두 번.
126|
127|“…….”
128|
129|씨벌, 못 해 먹겠네.
130|
131|나는 언어 설정을 찾아 헤매기 시작했다.
132|
133|
134|
135|* * *
136|
137|
138|
139|드르륵.
140|
141|평화 길드원들이 있는 병실로 들어섰다. 옹기종기 모여서 이야기를 나누고 있던 사람들이 나를 향해 고개를 돌린다.
142|
143|“어디 갔다 오길래 이렇게 늦…… 혹시 화장실 다녀왔어?”
144|
145|코를 움켜쥔 송송이의 말에 나는 음울하게 대답했다.
146|
147|“어떻게 알았냐.”
148|
149|“똥 냄새가 진동하길래.”
150|
151|“심해?”
152|
153|“응. 사람이 아니라 거대한 똥이 걸어오는 줄 알았어.”
154|
155|“덕담 고맙다. 기운이 나네.”
156|
157|냄새나는 화장실 칸막이에서 한 시간을 넘게 있다 보니 코가 마비됐다.
158|
159|나는 기운이 쪽 빠진 목소리로 대답하며 스테이플러로 찍은 A4 용지 묶음을 건넸다.
160|
161|“여기.”
162|
163|“이게 뭔데?”
164|
165|“널 위한 러브레터. 설사하면서 썼다.”
166|
167|“우웩, 우웨에엑!”
168|
169|“리액션 풍부한 것 보소.”
170|
171|“우웨에에엑!”
172|
173|“…….”
174|
175|리액션이 아니라 리얼이었네.
176|
177|이미 볼 장 다 봤다고 생각했지만, 마음 한구석이 아려 오는 건 어쩔 수 없다.
178|
179|“사랑했다…….”
180|
181|“우웨에에에엑!”
182|
183|“송송이 헌터님. 괜찮으십니까?”
184|
185|거세지는 헛구역질에 가장 가까이에 있던 김 집사가 나는 듯이 달려와 등을 두드려 주었다.
186|
187|그사이 송송이가 태극기처럼 휘두르던 A4 용지는 한 사람의 손에 넘어갔다.
188|
189|첫 면에 적힌 글자를 읽은 최 팀장이 나를 보며 피식 웃는다.
190|
191|“진가심법? 러브레터치고는 제목이 특이한데요.”
192|
193|“안에 적힌 내용은 더 특이할 겁니다.”
194|
195|“……네?”
196|
197|“계속 읽어 보세요.”
198|
199|최 팀장은 눈치가 빨랐다. 그는 즉시 자세를 바로 하고 신중한 얼굴로 페이지를 넘겼다.
200|
201|직접 썼다고는 믿기지 않을 만큼 기계 같은 필체 위를 한 쌍의 눈동자가 바쁘게 굴러다녔다.
202|
203|팔락. 팔락. 팔락…….
204|
205|속도는 점점 더 빨라졌고 최 팀장의 입술 사이로 더운 숨이 뿜어져 나왔다.
206|
207|순식간에 10여 페이지를 독파한 그가 고개를 번쩍 쳐들었다. 나를 보는 눈동자는 쟁반처럼 부풀어 있었다.
208|
209|“이건……!”
210|
211|그 반응에 나도 적잖이 놀랐다.
212|
213|‘이게 뭔지 알고 있다고?’
214|
215|말이 무공 비급이지, 막상 제작하고 보니 진가심법의 비급은 모르는 사람이 보면 한의학 서적으로 착각할 정도였다.
216|
217|인체에 존재하는 수많은 혈도의 위치와 그 기능, 공력을 운용하는 경로까지 표시되어 있으니까.
218|
219|송송이였다면 몇 장 보고 덮었을 테지만, 최 팀장의 반응은 생각했던 것 이상이었다.
220|
221|“뭔지 알아보겠습니까?”
222|
223|“예. 물론입니다.”
224|
225|이어 그의 입술 사이로 생전 처음 들어보는 명칭이 흘러나왔다.
226|
227|“이건…… 마나 연공법입니다.”
228|
229|“마나, 뭐요?”
230|
231|“마나 연공법 말입니다!”
232|
233|마나 연공법(Mana-練功法)?
234|
235|거, 누가 지었는지 이름 한 번 괴상하다.
236|
237|그때 최 팀장의 커진 목소리를 들은 김 집사가 후다닥 다가갔다.
238|
239|“지금 마나 연공법이라고 하셨습니까?”
240|
241|“네, 여기.”
242|
243|최 팀장으로부터 비급을 건네받은 김 집사가 황급히 페이지를 넘겼다.
244|
245|그리고 얼마 지나지 않아 비슷한 반응이 터져 나왔다.
246|
247|“헉.”
248|
249|“김 집사님이 보시기에 어떻습니까?”
250|
251|“확실합니다. 마나 연공법이 분명해요. 그런데 도대체 이걸 어디서?”
252|
253|화장실에서 가져왔는데요.
254|
255|최 팀장이 손가락을 들어 나를 가리켰다.
256|
257|“진태경 씨가…….”
258|
259|“진태경 헌터님이요?”
260|
261|휙! 우두둑!
262|
263|최 팀장의 말이 끝나기도 전에 김 집사의 고개가 맹렬한 소리와 함께 내 쪽을 향해 꺾였다.
264|
265|“진태경 헌터님께서 어떻게 마나 연공법을 갖고 계신 겁니까?”
266|
267|나는 침착하게 대답했다.
268|
269|“일단 저는 마나 연공법이 뭔지 모르고요. 당연히 저게 마나 연공법이라는 것 역시 금시초문입니다. 그나저나 목은 괜찮으세요? 방금 뼈 부러지는 소리가 들린 것 같은데…….”
270|
271|“지금 그게 대수입니까? 이깟 목, 부러져도 됩니다.”
272|
273|“……엄청 대수인 것 같은데.”
274|
275|되긴 뭐가 돼. 이 할아버지, 어째 날이 갈수록 터프해지시는 것 같다.
276|
277|물론 그만큼 이 문제가 중요하다는 뜻이겠지만.
278|
279|‘그나저나 마나 연공법이라. 이정룡이 그걸 익힌 거구나.’
280|
281|일종의 합성어라 처음에는 괴상하게 들렸는데, 몇 번 중얼거려보니 혀에 착 감긴다.
282|
283|단어에 담긴 뜻으로 헌터들이 쓰는 내공심법이라는 걸 유추하기는 그리 어렵지 않았다.
284|
285|그리고 이정룡과 그 수하들이 익힌 것이 바로 이 마나 연공법이라는 것도.
286|
287|“제 질문에 대한 답을 부탁드려도 되겠습니까?”
288|
289|“태경 씨, 이건 매우 중요한 문제입니다.”
290|
291|김 집사와 최 팀장의 눈빛은 그 어느 때보다 진지하고 심각했다.
292|
293|나는 짐짓 당황한 것처럼 눈을 굴리다가, 미리 준비해 온 대답을 던졌다.
294|
295|“글쎄요. 어릴 적에 아버지께서 알려 주신 거라…….”
296|
297|“외람되지만 혹시 돌아가신 선친(先親)을 말씀하시는 겁니까?”
298|
299|“네.”
300|
301|최 팀장이 미간을 좁혔다.
302|
303|“선친께서는 일반인이셨던 것으로 압니다만.”
304|
305|“맞아요.”
306|

“…”

[P63]
“Bleeeggh!”

“…”

[P68]
“Bleeeggh!”

Song Song would have read a few pages and closed it, but Team Leader Choi’s reaction went far beyond anything I had expected.

[P88]
“Do you recognize it?”

[P89]
“Yes. Of course.”

“This is a Mana Cultivation Method.”

[P92]
“A mana what?”

[P93]
“A Mana Cultivation Method!”

[P94]
*Mana Cultivation Method?*

[P95]
What a bizarre name. Whoever had coined it possessed a strange sense of style.

[P96]
Butler Kim hurried over when he heard Team Leader Choi raise his voice.

[P97]
“Did you just say Mana Cultivation Method?”

[P98]
“Yes. Here.”

[P99]
Butler Kim took the manual from Team Leader Choi and frantically flipped through the pages.

[P100]

[P101]
“Gasp.”

[P102]
“What do you think, Butler Kim?”

[P103]
“There’s no doubt about it. This is definitely a Mana Cultivation Method. But where on earth did this come from?”

The bathroom.

Team Leader Choi raised a finger and pointed at me.

[P106]
“Mr. Jin Taekyung…”

[P107]
“Hunter Jin Taekyung?”

Whip! Crack!

I answered calmly.

“For starters, I don’t know what a Mana Cultivation Method is. Naturally, this is also the first I’ve heard of that thing being one. By the way, is your neck all right? I could’ve sworn I just heard a bone break…”

[P114]
“…It sounds pretty important to me.”

[P115]
What did he mean, it could break? This old man seemed to be getting tougher by the day.

[P116]
Of course, that only showed how important this was.

*So Lee Jungryong learned a Mana Cultivation Method.*

[P118]

[P119]

[P120]
And that Lee Jungryong and his subordinates had learned precisely such a technique.

[P121]
“Could you please answer my question?”

[P122]
“Taekyung, this is extremely important.”

[P123]
Butler Kim and Team Leader Choi looked more grave than ever.

[P126]
“Pardon me, but are you referring to your late father?”

[P127]
“Yes.”

[P128]
Team Leader Choi furrowed his brow.

[P129]
“I understand your late father was an ordinary man.”

[P130]
“That’s right.”

“Then how did he know a Mana Cultivation Method…?”

[P132]
“He probably didn’t know either. When he taught it to me, he said it was just a health regimen passed down through our family.”

[P133]
“A health regimen?”

[P134]
“A Mana Cultivation Method passed down through the family…”

[P135]
As the two stared at me in disbelief, I pointed to the cover.

Four neat characters were printed there in lettering as clean as an office document’s font.

[P137]
**Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique**

[P138]
Even the name was perfect.

[P139]
If Shanxi Province had the Jin Family of Taiyuan, then Gyeonggi Province had the Jin Family of Goyang. Simple as that.

[P140]
If I claimed it was a family heirloom passed down through the generations, they wouldn’t have much to argue with.

[P141]
As expected, they were both briefly rendered speechless. I continued.

[P142]
“It’s a kind of breathing method. My father started teaching it to me when I was young, saying that practicing it would make me healthier. He even made me memorize something called a formula word for word.”

[P143]
“It is similar to a Mana Cultivation Method, but…”

[P144]
“Could we see the original? The original manual?”

[P145]
“After my father passed away, everything was so chaotic… I looked for it after we moved, but it was gone.”

[P146]
“Ah…”

[P147]
“That’s unfortunate.”

[P148]
“It is. Fortunately, I memorized every last word.”

[P149]
It was true that something I owned had disappeared. I had merely slipped the nonexistent original manual for the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique into the story.

[P150]
Perfect destruction of evidence. When they heard that even the original was gone, both of their shoulders sagged.

[P151]
*I’d love to see their faces if they knew this was the original.*

[P152]
The martial arts manuals people imagined all looked more or less the same.

[P153]
Half-rotted bamboo slips. Ancient books reeking of rat piss.

[P154]
They could go play jokgu.[^2] I didn’t have any of that crap.

[P155]
I stood the crisp stack of A4 paper upright and slammed a stapler through it. Murim martial artists would have been appalled, but a twenty-first-century martial arts manual deserved to look the part.

[P156]
“Still, this is extraordinary. A cultivation technique… I never imagined such a thing truly existed.”

[P157]
“I’ve seen them mentioned a few times in novels and movies. I believe they called them martial arts.”

[P158]
“You are correct, Young Master. In a sense, a Mana Cultivation Method is also a form of martial arts. Look here. It says that qi is circulated and accumulated through energy circulation, does it not? This operates on the same principle as a Mana Cultivation Method…”

[P159]
*Yeah, because it is martial arts.*

[P160]
While I fought back the words itching to escape my mouth, Team Leader Choi asked me a question.

[P161]
“Then, Mr. Jin Taekyung, have you been practicing a Mana Cultivation Method—or rather, the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique—since childhood?”

[P162]
“Yes.”

[P163]
“I’m sorry to put it this way, but its effects seem somewhat less impressive than expected…”

[P164]
Translated directly, he was asking, *If you had this, why did you spend seven years as an F-rank Hunter?*

[P165]
A sharp question. Also one I had expected.

[P166]
I answered without batting an eye.

[P167]
“As you know, I was quite skilled for an F-rank Hunter. I even received a commendation for graduating at the top of my training center.”

[P168]
“Ah, yes. I heard about that. I also know you served as a deputy team leader in your former Guild.”

[P169]
Granted, it had been a tiny, weak Guild, but F-rank Hunters were treated like punching bags wherever they went—like dog shit on the street.

[P170]
Unless they were related to the Guild’s leadership, it was extremely rare for an F-rank Hunter to become a deputy team leader. That was why my appointment had remained a hot topic within the Guild for quite some time.

[P171]
“There was a lot of talk about it. Hunters with higher ranks and more experience than me complained about seniority and grumbled that they should have come first… In the end, I proved myself through sheer ability. And the reason I could do that was the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique.”

[P172]
“Hmm.”

[P173]
“Looking at it that way, it does seem to have had some effect.”

[P174]
I knew.

[P175]
This alone wouldn’t be enough to convince them that the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique explained my past.

[P176]
I smiled faintly and looked around. Song Song had finally stopped retching, and even Im Kkeokjeong was watching me with curiosity, waiting for what I would say next.
